etatEtMoi.title: The State and I
etatEtMoi.lead: The State is made of women and men who act every day for the common good.
etatEtMoi.link: Discover the missions of the State

organisateur.desc: It organises collective life, enables democracy and ensures that laws are respected.

protecteur.desc: It provides full protection to every citizen.

facilitateur.desc: It supports life paths and ensures public services are accessible to everyone.

moteur.desc: It invests for the common good and prepares the future of the country.

promoteur.desc: It promotes a strong, sustainable and innovative economy.

influent.desc: It defends Astoria's sovereignty and gives the Republic a voice in the world.

grandsDossiers.title: Major topics
grandsDossiers.lead: Explore the State's major topics: equality, transformation, innovation… and follow the progress of public policies.

egalite.desc: The cross-ministerial plan for equality between women and men: concrete measures to act on the professional, economic and social fronts.

astoria2030.desc: Astoria 2030 aims to accelerate the transformation of key sectors of our economy through innovation and to build the country of tomorrow.

grandAngle.desc: An unprecedented listening and assessment approach across the whole territory to understand how citizens perceive the action of the State.

prevention.title: Preventing and managing major risks
prevention.lead: From minor incidents to major disasters, many events of natural or human origin can affect people. Anticipate them and adopt the right reflexes.

sePreparer.desc: Right reflexes, emergency kit and family plan: learn how to deal with emergency situations.

canicule.desc: Protect yourself and your loved ones during heatwaves.

cyber.desc: Recognise threats, protect your data and adopt the right reflexes against cyber risks.

terroriste.desc: Learn about the right behaviours and the security framework in the face of the terrorist threat.

government.title: The Government
government.description: Overview of the Government of the Republic of Astoria, its organisation and its missions.
government.lead: This section presents the organisation of the Government of the Republic of Astoria: its composition, its services and how to contact it.

paragraphs.p1: The Government directs and coordinates the policy of the Nation. It is made up of the head of government and the ministers in charge of the various ministerial portfolios.
paragraphs.p2: This portal aims to make government action more legible: the organisation of institutions, official announcements, related procedures and services are progressively documented here.

government.notice: The detailed presentation of the institutions and their missions is being drafted for this preview foundation.

composition.title: Government composition
composition.description: The composition of the Government of the Republic of Astoria: presidency, council of ministers and public administrations.
composition.lead: The Government of the Republic of Astoria is organised around the presidency of the Republic, the council of ministers and the public administrations.

paragraphs.p1: The official list of the members of the Government (head of government, ministers and secretaries of state) and the allocation of ministerial portfolios will be published in this section.
paragraphs.p2: Each institution will have a dedicated page: missions, organisation, news and related procedures.

composition.notice: The detailed composition will be published as soon as official data is available.
